summary: This directory is responsible for managing and resolving prompt templates, providing a dedicated mechanism to load prompt content from files relative to specified module URLs for automated tasks.
responsibilities: Manage and resolve prompt templates for automated generation tasks
Load prompt content from files relative to module URLs
relationships: Prompt loaders retrieve prompt content from file paths relative to specific module URLs to supply instructional logic for generation tasks.
designDecisions: Decoupling of template retrieval and prompt loading from internal execution tasks.
